title: DDPM
core_mech: 预设离散高斯前向链，加训练稳定的 epsilon/score 网络，再按学习到的随机逆链逐步采样。
core_mech_en: Defines a fixed discrete Markov Gaussian forward noising chain and trains a noise-prediction U-Net (ε_θ) across all noise scales for iterative reverse sampling.
input_desc: 训练时的干净样本 x0；生成时的高斯噪声 xT
input_en: Clean training image x_0 (during training); pure Gaussian noise x_T ~ N(0,I) (during sampling)
output_desc: 经 T 步随机逆扩散得到的样本 x0_hat
output_en: Sample x̂_0 synthesized via T iterative stochastic reverse denoising steps

source.title: DDPM
notes: GitHub supplied no detected license and no root LICENSE/COPYING notice was found at this commit. Per-file permissions were not exhaustively audited; no permission to copy is inferred.

adapter.name: DDPM
adapter.mechanism: Original linear beta schedule, epsilon-MSE objective and consecutive ancestral reverse transitions.
limitations: Compact time-conditioned U-Net; default prior training uses 1000 time indices, and ancestral generation requires all 1000 steps.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
